external_entities.name: Store manager
external_entities.description: A store manager who uses the scheduling web app to build the weekly rota for their store.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Store managers use a scheduling web app to build the weekly rota for their store.

external_entities.name: Colleague
external_entities.description: A colleague who uses the scheduling web app to look at assigned shifts.
external_entities.source_excerpt: Colleagues use the same app to look at the shifts they have been given.
external_entities.notes: Colleagues reach the app from their own phones.

processes.name: Scheduling web app
processes.description: A web app used by store managers to build weekly rotas and by colleagues to view assigned shifts.
processes.source_excerpt: Store managers use a scheduling web app to build the weekly rota for their store.
processes.notes: Authentication and how the app identifies the scheduling service are undocumented.

processes.name: Scheduling service
processes.description: The service that reads and writes rotas and creates the weekly payroll export.
processes.source_excerpt: The scheduling service is what actually reads and writes the rotas
processes.notes: The service is on the internal network. How the web app and scheduling service identify each other is undocumented.

processes.name: Payroll system
processes.description: A payroll system run by another team that collects the payroll export from the file share.
processes.source_excerpt: The payroll system, which is run by another team, collects the export from the file share.
processes.notes: How the payroll system is identified when it collects the export is undocumented.
